decisions.reason: Proven government adoption and very strong fit with the firm's travel-security capabilities mean the option has already shown clear value and is unlikely to be withdrawn.
As a relatively low-cost adjacent compliance API, it is still worth keeping open, but after two years without strong visible traction the case for withdrawal has become more material.
With weak market evidence and persistently high regulatory, ethical, and customer-acceptance risk in Germany and the EU, the option no longer justifies further commitment.
The platform remains closely linked to the firm's core document and passenger-processing offer, and the cost of continuing to learn from the market appears low relative to its strategic fit.
